# PostgreSQL 17 与 MySQL 8.4 的 JSON 索引对比：类型、可加速运算符与索引代价

本对比基于官方文档，从 JSON 索引类型、可加速的查询运算符与索引代价三个方面考察 PostgreSQL 17 与 MySQL 8.4。MySQL 8.4 的 InnoDB 仅支持在虚拟生成列上建立二级索引，不支持其他索引类型；其多值索引可在 WHERE 子句中优化 JSON_OVERLAPS() 查询；在虚拟列上使用二级索引会因 INSERT 与 UPDATE 时物化虚拟列值而带来额外写入代价。PostgreSQL 17 方面，jsonb_path_ops 操作符类通常比 jsonb_ops 索引更小，并且当查询包含数据中频繁出现的键时搜索特异性更好；jsonb_path_ops 仅支持 @>、@? 和 @@ 运算符，但相比默认的 jsonb_ops 操作符类具有显著的性能优势。需要指出的是，关于 PostgreSQL 17 可加速的查询运算符，证据尚不完整，因此该维度仍有未回答之处。

## JSON 索引类型

在索引类型方面，MySQL 8.4 的 InnoDB 支持在虚拟生成列上建立二级索引，其他索引类型不受支持。与此同时，PostgreSQL 17 提供了 jsonb_path_ops 与 jsonb_ops 两个操作符类：其中 jsonb_path_ops 操作符类仅支持 @>、@? 和 @@ 运算符，但相对默认的 jsonb_ops 具有显著的性能优势。 [evidence:620ea8de9fd9ea143a343e8de91bcb50249d4ca58cc53ea9] [evidence:4d37c1576570ca0a0f47fcb0e88640e1c46160e4b6796a37]

## 可加速的查询运算符

在查询运算符优化方面，MySQL 8.4 的 InnoDB 表上，对 JSON 列使用 JSON_OVERLAPS() 的 WHERE 子句查询可以通过多值索引进行优化。对于 PostgreSQL 17，jsonb_path_ops 操作符类所支持的查询限于 @>、@? 和 @@ 运算符；不过，关于该版本中哪些具体运算符可被索引加速，现有证据尚不足以给出完整说明。 [evidence:ae6397359e83deab646790a7ad5fac89eeff06ac0f21e962] [evidence:4d37c1576570ca0a0f47fcb0e88640e1c46160e4b6796a37]

## 索引代价

在索引代价方面，MySQL 8.4 使用基于虚拟列的二级索引时，由于在 INSERT 和 UPDATE 操作期间需要物化二级索引记录中的虚拟列值，会带来额外的写入代价。PostgreSQL 17 的 jsonb_path_ops 索引通常在相同数据上比 jsonb_ops 索引小得多，并且搜索特异性更好，尤其当查询包含数据中频繁出现的键时。 [evidence:d5675dea1504eaf8185c9b43f231ac34da2f52a06e9b5335] [evidence:409020cdabaa4b4f19b2dd787ace5b171c02eb4e6c10f5b3]

## 对比表

| 产品 | JSON 索引类型 | 可加速的查询运算符 | 索引代价 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| MySQL 8.4 | InnoDB 支持在虚拟生成列上建立二级索引；其他索引类型不受支持。 | 在 InnoDB 表的 JSON 列上，WHERE 子句中使用 JSON_OVERLAPS() 的查询可通过多值索引优化。 | 使用基于虚拟列的二级索引时，因 INSERT 与 UPDATE 期间物化二级索引记录中的虚拟列值而产生额外写入代价。 [evidence:620ea8de9fd9ea143a343e8de91bcb50249d4ca58cc53ea9] [evidence:ae6397359e83deab646790a7ad5fac89eeff06ac0f21e962] [evidence:d5675dea1504eaf8185c9b43f231ac34da2f52a06e9b5335] |
| PostgreSQL 17 | jsonb_path_ops 操作符类仅支持 @>、@? 和 @@ 运算符，但相比默认的 jsonb_ops 操作符类具有显著的性能优势。 | jsonb_path_ops 操作符类支持的查询限于 @>、@? 和 @@ 运算符；关于可被索引加速的运算符的完整范围，现有证据不足以说明。 | jsonb_path_ops 索引通常比相同数据上的 jsonb_ops 索引小得多，搜索特异性更好，尤其当查询包含数据中频繁出现的键时。 [evidence:4d37c1576570ca0a0f47fcb0e88640e1c46160e4b6796a37] [evidence:409020cdabaa4b4f19b2dd787ace5b171c02eb4e6c10f5b3] |

## 引用核对

### Queries on JSON columns of [\`InnoDB\`](innodb-storage-engine.html "Chapter 17 The InnoDB Storage Engine") tables using \`JSON_OVERLAPS()\` in the \`WHERE\` clause can be optimized using multi-valued indexes.

- 研究项：`MySQL 8.4 · 可加速的查询运算符`
- 候选：`27314693-5b0c-434f-b64a-1b3e4c404733`
- Evidence: `evidence:ae6397359e83deab646790a7ad5fac89eeff06ac0f21e962`
  - Exact quote: “Queries on JSON columns of [\`InnoDB\`](innodb-storage-engine.html "Chapter 17 The InnoDB Storage Engine") tables using \`JSON_OVERLAPS()\` in the \`WHERE\` clause can be optimized using multi-valued indexes.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/8b1c85cf-a380-4704-b6c9-118d783a90c4/07e7777021f89609dd4b0b489ce92e71987e1b3905beb99bdfecdb2bee3558a0`
  - URL: https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/json-search-functions.html

### There are additional write costs to consider when using a secondary index on a virtual column due to computation performed when materializing virtual column values in secondary index records during [\`INSERT\`](insert.html "15.2.7 INSERT Statement") and [\`UPDATE\`](update.html "15.2.17 UPDATE Statement") operations.

- 研究项：`MySQL 8.4 · 索引代价`
- 候选：`ee05f096-1494-48f8-b0d9-e29ddc86f9c7`
- Evidence: `evidence:d5675dea1504eaf8185c9b43f231ac34da2f52a06e9b5335`
  - Exact quote: “There are additional write costs to consider when using a secondary index on a virtual column due to computation performed when materializing virtual column values in secondary index records during [\`INSERT\`](insert.html "15.2.7 INSERT Statement") and [\`UPDATE\`](update.html "15.2.17 UPDATE Statement") operations.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/8b1c85cf-a380-4704-b6c9-118d783a90c4/f807adcec94d9fb1cc049fb83cfa0641d089b41d399afa34a6ebffa86d1c389d`
  - URL: https://dev.mysql.com/doc/en/create-table-secondary-indexes.html

### \`InnoDB\` supports secondary indexes on virtual generated columns. Other index types are not supported.

- 研究项：`MySQL 8.4 · JSON 索引类型`
- 候选：`cb517b61-a7ac-460b-971d-dd3b08dc4c76`
- Evidence: `evidence:620ea8de9fd9ea143a343e8de91bcb50249d4ca58cc53ea9`
  - Exact quote: “\`InnoDB\` supports secondary indexes on virtual generated columns. Other index types are not supported.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/8f54ad26-7e6f-4c26-83c4-4456d59b808c/7fe0dedb23acc8e3090c36c0e534f2a9bff5a04217444f12059449093ac15212`
  - URL: https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/create-table-secondary-indexes.html

### A \`jsonb_path_ops\` index is usually much smaller than a \`jsonb_ops\` index over the same data, and the specificity of searches is better, particularly when queries contain keys that appear frequently in the data.

- 研究项：`PostgreSQL 17 · 索引代价`
- 候选：`a1d69189-6f59-4469-81e0-989a72b1d7a8`
- Evidence: `evidence:409020cdabaa4b4f19b2dd787ace5b171c02eb4e6c10f5b3`
  - Exact quote: “A \`jsonb_path_ops\` index is usually much smaller than a \`jsonb_ops\` index over the same data, and the specificity of searches is better, particularly when queries contain keys that appear frequently in the data.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/f4d82a48-29ac-492c-8a09-098b55ac4089/89a8ddf3a7364fcfb64d973daa4e91cbe36d36c3aade96c52bf94e8bd3581c5c`
  - URL: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/datatype-json.html

### Although the \`jsonb_path_ops\` operator class supports only queries with the \`@>\`, \`@?\` and \`@@\` operators, it has notable performance advantages over the default operator class \`jsonb_ops\`.

- 研究项：`PostgreSQL 17 · JSON 索引类型`
- 候选：`f40f4194-a844-4d36-b541-3cabdf2b9e6e`
- Evidence: `evidence:4d37c1576570ca0a0f47fcb0e88640e1c46160e4b6796a37`
  - Exact quote: “Although the \`jsonb_path_ops\` operator class supports only queries with the \`@>\`, \`@?\` and \`@@\` operators, it has notable performance advantages over the default operator class \`jsonb_ops\`.”
  - Snapshot: `research/external/f4d82a48-29ac-492c-8a09-098b55ac4089/89a8ddf3a7364fcfb64d973daa4e91cbe36d36c3aade96c52bf94e8bd3581c5c`
  - URL: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/datatype-json.html

## 局限与未解决项

- **PostgreSQL 17 · 可加速的查询运算符**：必需研究项未找到足够证据（`REQUIRED_CELL_UNRESOLVED`，`GAP`）
- REQUIRED_CELLS_PARTIALLY_RESOLVED
- UNRESOLVED_CELLS_REMAIN
